name: comp-352

frames.best_why: A top question is open with a nested question expanded and its answer visible, showing both levels.

tagline: Faq rows open to reveal a second layer of smaller collapsible questions.
summary: A five-line FAQ accordion whose open answer holds two more collapsible questions. Opening one top row closes the others; nested rows show or hide their explanation.
appearance: Under a bold Multi-level heading, four bordered rows stack into a single panel on a dark page. Each row is a bold question with a chevron at the right; an open row reveals two lighter nested rows, each with its own small chevron and optional grey answer text.
behaviour: Opening a top question animates its nested list into view, rotates its chevron and closes any other open top row. Each nested question toggles independently, showing a short muted answer; the third top row opens by default.
demo_content: Heading 'Multi-level'; FAQ questions about coss ui features, customising, performance and accessibility.
search_phrases: nested accordion for categories and subcategories
click a question to reveal sub questions
settings panel with grouped collapsible rows
use_when: When one answer naturally splits into deeper follow-up questions that should stay tucked away.
avoid_when: Deep rows shrink the tap area and the faint nested text is low contrast on dark.
customise: All questions and answers sit in one nested array in the file; changing them means editing the source, while width and colours follow utility classes.
weight_why: A handful of rows and two short collapsible animations; no background loop.

a11y.note: Rows are buttons with visible focus rings and correct expanded state; nested answers animate with no reduced-motion fallback.

issues: The heading 'Multi-level' is a developer label rather than user-facing copy.
Nested answer text is very faint against the dark background.
polish_why: Nesting reads clearly and borders align; demo headings and faint nested text hold it back.
